beast.translation: n. 畜生, 动物, 野兽, 兽性

beast epic.translation: 动物寓言诗(以动物为主人公的叙事诗)

beasthood.definition: n. State or nature of a beast.
beasthood.translation: n. 野兽；畜生, 人面兽心的人 (beast的变形)

beasting.translation: n. ☉(除人之外的)动物；(与人相对而言的)兽；(与植物相对而言的)动物

beastliness.definition:
n. the quality of being deliberately mean
n. unpleasant nastiness; used especially of nasty weather
beastliness.translation: n. 兽性, 酩酊大醉, 贪食, 粗鲁, 淫猥, 残暴

beastly.definition:
s. very unpleasant
s. resembling a beast; showing lack of human sensibility
r. in a beastly manner
beastly.translation: a. 野兽的, 残忍的, 令人厌憎的

beastman.translation: n. 牧人；残暴的人, 残忍的人

beastmen.translation: (beastman 的复数) n. 牧人；残暴的人, 残忍的人

beasts.definition:
n a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
n a cruelly rapacious person
beasts.translation: n. 野兽；畜牲（beast 的复数）

beaswax.translation:
n. 蜂蜡
vt. 给...上蜂蜡
